source: Exact frozen joint3 RGB detector, unchanged original head and actual November pseudo-IR files.
rule: Current RGB teacher boxes with scores>=0.7; central half-box median versus 1.25x ring excluding all current boxes. Vote contrast-polarity product only when both abs contrasts>=8 levels and each region has>=16 pixels; score-weighted negative total vote inverts IR before CDF. No GT/previous/future input. No valid votes means no inversion.
histogram: 256-level monotone current-IR to current-gray inverse-CDF with only positive-count histogram bins. Round uint8 LUT. Gray self-CDF must be byte-exact. Use existing Train gray mean/std for mapped/gray-normalized streams, original IR mean/std only for ir_raw.
outputs: All24 predicted proposal arrays and contrast diagnostics frozen/hash serialized before any GT scoring; no new image/FPN cache. Train-only per-video proposal recall/precision at IoU0.5 and scores0.1,0.6,0.7. No HOTA claim.
activation: Diagnostic only. Consider further mapped-IR fitting only if polarity-CDF improves recall@0.6 over raw IR on>=4/6 Train videos and paired cosine current-versus-wrong-frame contrast improves over raw IR on>=4/6 videos. Otherwise retain negative evidence without a new cache. Any future fit requires a separate frozen plan, same adapter/loss/budget and strongest existing RGB/gray controls.
resources: Queue only physical GPU3 after all staged removal producers complete. Physical GPU2 remains assigned to temporal controls. No additional whole-frame dataset or full feature bank.
novelty: Classical photometric matching is not a standalone innovation; this diagnoses compatibility of generated contrast with the frozen RGB encoder.
